name: germline CNV detection benchmark (gene panels)
description: Compares state-of-the-art methods for detecting germline copy-number variants from targeted gene panel sequencing, measuring sensitivity, precision, and breakpoint accuracy across test datasets.
evaluation_method: sensitivity / precision / breakpoint_accuracy (often reported alongside F1)
reputation: A focused, clinically-relevant benchmark commonly used in bioinformatics and clinical genomics to compare CNV callers on targeted gene panels.
notes: Non-LLM genomics benchmark; performance depends strongly on panel design, coverage, and CNV size (exon-level events are harder); datasets can be small and panel-specific; synthetic truth sets or simulated CNVs may bias results; breakpoint resolution varies by method and sequencing protocol.
